meetdock.welcome.contents:
Welcome to MeetDock-Solo!

💡 Drag & Drop
You can drag & drop .ics files or invitation text directly into the Meetings section above to add meetings.

🏢 Enterprise Teams

• Select .ics File
[📁 Select .ics File to Register](command:meetdock-solo.addFromFile)

• Add from Clipboard
Copy meeting invitation text and click Add from Clipboard (Alt+M / Option+M).
[📋 Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard)

$(warning) Note (Enterprise): Some .ics files saved from email attachments or certain notification emails may contain only an individual occurrence (RECURRENCE-ID) and no recurrence rule (RRULE). In that case, the meeting is registered as a one-time meeting. You can configure recurrence after registering the meeting.

👤 Personal Teams

• Add from Clipboard / Text
Copy the meeting join link or invitation text and click Add from Clipboard (Alt+M / Option+M).
[📋 Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard)

• Configure Settings
Select the title, date/time, and recurrence pattern in the dialog to register.
